settings.ceo_bio:
For twenty years, DADO has been shaping the culture of ceramics in Uzbekistan. To us, tile is not merely a building material but a foundation that gives a space its character and keeps its appearance for years. The ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART and SEVEN brands were created with exactly this outlook.

The trust of our clients is our greatest value. We approach every order with care, from quality control to delivery and follow-up advice. We look forward to welcoming you to the DADO showroom and finding the right solution for your home or project together.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
Yigirma yil davomida DADO O‘zbekistonda keramika madaniyatini shakllantirib kelmoqda. Biz uchun plitka shunchaki qurilish materiali emas, balki makonga xarakter beradigan, yillar davomida o‘z ko‘rinishini saqlaydigan asosdir. ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART va SEVEN brendlari aynan shu qarash asosida yaratilgan.

Mijozlarimizning ishonchi bizning eng katta qadriyatimizdir. Biz har bir buyurtmaga mas’uliyat bilan yondashamiz: sifat nazoratidan tortib, yetkazib berish va keyingi maslahatgacha. Sizni DADO showroomida ko‘rishdan va uyingiz yoki loyihangiz uchun eng to‘g‘ri yechimni birga topishdan mamnun bo‘lamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
На протяжении двадцати лет DADO формирует культуру керамики в Узбекистане. Для нас плитка — не просто строительный материал, а основа, которая придаёт пространству характер и сохраняет свой вид долгие годы. Бренды ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART и SEVEN созданы именно с этим подходом.

Доверие наших клиентов — наша главная ценность. Мы ответственно подходим к каждому заказу: от контроля качества до доставки и последующих консультаций. Будем рады видеть вас в шоуруме DADO и вместе подобрать наиболее подходящее решение для вашего дома или проекта.

The trust of our clients is our greatest value. We approach every order with care, from quality control to delivery and follow-up advice. We look forward to welcoming you to the DADO showroom and finding the right solution for your home or project together.

news.title: SEVEN: DADO's premium porcelain stoneware brand
news.excerpt: Black marble, golden veining and large formats: SEVEN collections are now in the DADO showroom.

news.title: Partnership programme for designers and architects
news.excerpt: DADO launches a partnership programme for interior designers and architects: a sample library, project consultations and the option to meet clients in the showroom.

news.title: ITALICA: concrete and terrazzo in 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats
news.excerpt: The new ITALICA collection is devoted to large format: 600×1200 and 800×1600 slabs with concrete and terrazzo looks. We explain why large format is the designers' choice today.

news.title: Interior trends 2026: what tile has to offer
news.excerpt: Natural textures, calm colours and large formats are the main directions in interior design for 2026. How to find them in the ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART collections.

history.title: DADO is founded
history.text: DADO is founded in Tashkent. Its first focus is supplying the construction market with quality imported ceramics. The principle of long-term client relationships takes shape in these early years.

history.title: The first showroom
history.text: The company's first showroom opens in Tashkent. Clients can now see tile in an interior context and handle samples in person. This step turns DADO from a supplier into an advising partner.

history.title: Own brands: ROMA, ITALICA, GRESART
history.text: DADO launches its own brands. ROMA embodies classic marble and stone, ITALICA modern minimalism, and GRESART bold design and decorative surfaces. Every collection is produced and inspected to the company's specifications.

history.title: A service for projects
history.text: A dedicated service for architects and designers was launched: technical advice, sample work and delivery planning brought together in one place. Working with large projects became faster and more precise.

history.title: 20 years and a new showroom concept
history.text: DADO marks its twentieth year. The new showroom concept presents all three brands in dedicated zones with real interior scenes. The company continues to develop delivery to every region of Uzbekistan and its partner network.

values.title: Our mission
values.text: Our mission is to offer every home and project in Uzbekistan quality, beautiful and durable ceramics at clear prices. We help clients choose, take responsibility for quality and see delivery through to the end.

values.title: Our vision
values.text: We aim to become a mark of trust and taste in ceramics across Central Asia. Each of our brands has its own style, and together they offer a complete solution for architects, designers and homeowners.
